notes.title: Happy Anniversary, Porcupines!
notes.notes:
Hello Porcupine residents!

It's been a year now since we invited you to explore and cherish our beloved Porcupine. Today, we have a special message to share with all of you from a group known as “Critical Rabbit.” These thoughtful rabbits have something important to convey, so without further ado, the stage is all theirs!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009137/00bd20990436e6a585cf5273e72883394718382c.png[/img]

It's summer now, and a year ago, we launched Fall of Porcupine and it's been quite a journey for us. This was our very first game release, and we've been deeply moved by all your heartfelt mails, comments, messages, fan art, streams, reviews, tattoos—everything.
We had no idea how supportive, productive and positive a community can be. We were also honored with four nominations at the German Video Game Awards - even for “The Best German Game” category (still can't believe that) - and two nominations at the German Developer Awards, which was mind-blowing for us. Everything started here…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009137/30e5c2a6201b4866731c9a27befc718053cfb9c5.png[/img]

I am Sebastian Hesse, Narrative Designer at Critical Rabbit, and this right here is a very early vision of our beloved pigeon doctor Finley. He's come a long way, hasn't he? And just like him, we have changed and have grown too. Fall of Porcupine looks so damn cute and cozy, but I wanted to address a topic that, in my opinion, isn't very popular or highlighted enough. This little fella right here was my way of expressing the issues we have in our healthcare system. The experiences of real hospital staff, whom we spoke with during the COVID-19 pandemic, served as a source of inspiration for Fall of Porcupine and I want to appreciate their incredible daily work.
Last but not least, I’m grateful for such a nice team, to make a game like this even possible. I had one of the most happiest and intense periods of my life. So thank you to all the creative and productive people who spent their time for Finley and his friends.
Maybe we’ll come back some day - but for now, our journey takes a different direction.

I hope you had a great time in Porcupine. And if you haven't been there yet, pay the city a visit. And please say Hi for me.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009137/3ab8c509f659d6ab9ff5c41448e1ac703ee73a06.jpg[/img]

[h3]City pigeon in a small-town hospital[/h3]
Thank you to everyone who appreciated our message and gave us a chance to shine a light on all those hard-working people out there. Thank you for playing and reviewing our very first game. Thank you for making Fall of Porcupine come alive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009137/e190a4ca63c40e4739f3c3d04977c7f6f2b40a03.jpg[/img]

[h3]A big concluding THANK YOU from everyone at Critical Rabbit[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009137/9be4b7824a355cd7507405df879e913e207a2c9c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009137/39bfaac1bfb812ad865b1825eb3cc36cc9f66d11.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Fall of Porcupine is available now!
notes.notes:
Finally Finley is here!
You can join Dr. Finley on an unforgettable Adventure, that reflects an unhealthy healthcare system, now in the highly anticipated 2D-narrative adventure [b]Fall of Porcupine[/b]!

[b]Fall of Porcupine[/b] is a heartfelt tale about the hardships endured by healthcare workers. A true love letter to the journey of self-discovery and self-love, [b]Fall of Porcupine[/b] celebrates the joys that come with life’s small (and big) accomplishments.

Showcased as part of Wholesome Direct 2023, it is a deeply moving narrative adventure featuring thematic mini-games, a full town to explore, charming characters, and beautifully illustrated backdrops. While [b]Fall of Porcupine[/b] tackles difficult subjects like grief, depression, death, and workplace politics, it approaches each of these topics sensitively and with great care for real-life healthcare professionals struggling with a demanding work culture.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1710540/Fall_of_Porcupine/?utm_source=steamnews&utm_campaign=outnow

[h3]Watch the new Fall of Porcupine release trailer now:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=njLOYTP7-zw;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]Key Features of Fall of Porcupine:[/h3]
[list][*][b]Where the Wild Things Get their Healthcare:[/b] Build relationships with the eclectic and intriguing citizens of Porcupine through deep and engaging conversations. Watch your words, as who knows just what might get you on someone's bad side.
[*][b]Soft and Sensitive:[/b] Finley’s adventures (and misadventures) lead to sensitive territory dealing with themes like death, illness, mental health, and grief. [b]Fall of Porcupine[/b] sensitively tackles each of these with approachable storylines, relatable characters, and resonating dialogue. 
[*][b]A Journey for the Whole Family:[/b] Fall of Porcupine’s tightly-built gameplay and controls means that anybody can pick up and play with ease. No matter if you’re a first-time player or a 2D side-scrolling expert, [b]Fall of Porcupine[/b] will make you feel right at home.
[*][b]Oh, the Places You’ll See (and Hear):[/b] The wonderfully illustrated world of [b]Fall of Porcupine[/b] will take you through a beautiful world of color and wonder, while the top-tier soundtrack will resonate every moment from the tips of your eardrums to the bottom of your heart.
[/list]

[h3]Play the free Prologue now![/h3]
If you want to take a look at the game, before buying it, you can play the [b]free prologue[/b]!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1710540/Fall_of_Porcupine/?utm_source=steamnews&utm_campaign=outnow

Are you ready to take your shift in [b]Fall of Porcupine[/b]?
On June 15th, you will be able to take the role of Finley, a young intern who has just started working in the local Hospital in the city of Porcupine. You will build relationships with the citizens of Porcupine, and, of course, experience stories of your patients. But be aware, that some of Finley's adventures will lead him to sensitive territory, dealing with themes like death, illness, mental health and grief. [h3]About Fall of Porcupine[/h3]
Delicately dealing with difficult subject matter while also doubling down on the importance of friendship, Fall of Porcupine tells an emotional story from the perspective of a fledgling doctor in a lovingly illustrated world. Finley is a fresh new face in the town of Porcupine, and players must guide the wet-behind-the-ears doctor through his first few weeks of medical residency. At first glance, the small town of Porcupine is a quaint, friendly place where everyone knows and warmly greets each other. However, after living there for any length of time, it’s clear that not everyone is as honest as they appear to be. As if that wasn’t devastating enough, Finley will be confronted with a different dilemma altogether: the collision of work and daily life – a reflection of an unhealthy and systemic issue in the healthcare industry at large.

Featuring fun mini-games, sleek platforming, and branching dialog choices, Fall of Porcupine delivers a heartfelt and spirited story of friendship, self-sacrifice, and self-love. Finley must run, jump, and glide through the town of Porcupine, while also diagnosing the townsfolks’ ailments and reporting to the head doctor, who’s far from kind or supportive. Explore the outskirts of town, hang out with friends, and unearth the secrets that keep Porcupine shrouded in mystery.

notes.title: Devlog: Fall of Porcupine will be Free for 1000 Health Care Workers in 2023
notes.notes:
The holiday season is in full swing, and as many of us prepare to nestle down for the next week, we (Assemble and indie studio [i][b]BUNTSPECHT.GAMES[/b][/i]) are thrilled to share some news sure to make you feel as warm and fuzzy as your favorite hot cocoa.

We are happy to announce today that [b]Fall of Porcupine[/b], our recently-announced cozy adventure game that deals with the hardships faced in the healthcare industry, [b]will be available — for free — for 1,000 healthcare professionals when the game launches in 2023. [/b]
This special offer is limited solely to healthcare professionals using the Steam platform in the US, UK, Canada, Germany, Switzerland, and Austria.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009137/b758239d6b5c9bbc11fcd8724142ff2945072985.png[/img]

Honoring the announcement, the dev-team has released an [b]all-new devlog[/b] video discussing the inspirations and themes behind their first-ever published title. 

[h3]Watch the latest Fall of Porcupine devlog video here: [/h3]
[previewyoutube=feTfYu5T8N0;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Fall of Porcupine[/b]’s poignant premise is based upon over 20 interviews conducted by the dev-team with healthcare professionals from varying sectors. 
As a “thank you” to those who participated, and every other individual that makes sacrifices to serve others, the teams conjured the idea to literally give back. 

For those healthcare professionals interested in redeeming the offer on Steam, please reach out directly to [u][i][b]healthcare@porcupine.game[/b][/i][/u] and read the [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1JnLPLQwez-N79vCMGLYGxPnRyIn1j3IF/view]Conditions for Participation[/url]. 


[h3]About Fall of Porcupine[/h3]
[b]Fall of Porcupine[/b] follows [i]Finley[/i], a freshly graduated med school student preparing for his first residency in a brand new small town that seems warm and inviting…at first. [i]Finley[/i] must lean on his friends for advice and support as he navigates an “unhealthy” healthcare industry rooting for his demise, all while prioritizing his mental health and self-care. The game is a heartfelt, important tale about the hardships endured by healthcare workers, while also delivering itself as a love letter to the human journey of self discovery, self-love, and the joys that come with life’s small (and big) accomplishments.

[b]Fall of Porcupine is coming to Steam, Nintendo Switch, Playstation 4/5, Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S in 2023.[/b] 
The free prologue, called The Last Days of Summer, is currently available on all platforms, and has already enjoyed over 100,000 downloads. 

[h3]Play the free Fall of Porcupine Prologue on Steam now:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1710540/Fall_of_Porcupine/


[h3]Last but not least: [/h3]
[b]Happy Holidays everybody and a great start into 2023! Stay safe! Stay healthy! [/b]

[i][b]Greetings and wishes from the teams of
- BUNTSPECHT.GAMES & Assemble Entertainment -[/b][/i]

notes.title: Fall of Porcupine Coming in 2023 - Free Prologue now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
[i]Life can be rough for a fledgling internist, as young Finley is about to find out. [/i]

Today, we (indie publisher Assemble Entertainment) and newly minted German studio BUNTSPECHT.GAMES unveil a true love letter to wholesome indie adventures and the hardships faced by healthcare workers: [b]Fall of Porcupine. [/b]

[h3]Fall of Porcupine will launch in 2023 on PC via Steam and GOG, Nintendo Switch, Xbox One and Series X|S, and PlayStation 4|5.[/h3]

[b]Celebrating the announcement, the publisher released a free prologue on Steam, PlayStation and Xbox, with availability on Nintendo Switch as of August 30, 2022.[/b]

[h3]Mark the date: Fall of Porcupine 'IGN Awesome Indies Show 'world premiere[/h3]
As part of gamescom 2022, the official announcement trailer for Fall Of Porcupine will be unveiled world-exclusively by IGN during the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UmSoA8D1-mA&list=PLraFbwCoisJB3n79G4dRlJZ6GZ8PuluoM]Awesome Indies Show[/url] on Friday evening starting at 5:00pm: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UmSoA8D1-mA&list=PLraFbwCoisJB3n79G4dRlJZ6GZ8PuluoM

[h3]Watch the full announcement trailer already here:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=pthv43zvNR0;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]About Fall Of Porcupine [/h3]
Delicately dealing with difficult subject matter while also doubling down on the importance of friendship, Fall of Porcupine tells an emotional story from the perspective of a fledgling doctor in a lovingly illustrated world. Finley is a fresh new face in the town of Porcupine, and players must guide the wet-behind-the-ears doctor through his first few weeks of medical residency. At first glance, the small town of Porcupine is a quaint, friendly place where everyone knows and warmly greets each other. However, after living there for any length of time, it’s clear that not everyone is as honest as they appear to be. As if that wasn’t devastating enough, Finley will be confronted with a different dilemma altogether: the collision of work and daily life – a reflection of an unhealthy and systemic issue in the healthcare industry at large.

Featuring fun mini-games, sleek platforming, and branching dialog choices, Fall of Porcupine delivers a heartfelt and spirited story of friendship, self-sacrifice, and self-love. Finley must run, jump, and glide through the town of Porcupine, while also diagnosing the townsfolks’ ailments and reporting to the head doctor, who’s far from kind or supportive. Explore the outskirts of town, hang out with friends, and unearth the secrets that keep Porcupine shrouded in mystery.

[h3]Features of Fall of Porcupine: [/h3]
[list][*] [b]You’ve Got a Friend in Me:[/b] Engage in funny, profound, and serious dialogues with townsfolk, where you can choose from branching dialogue trees. Choose wisely, as they influence character relationships.
[*] [b]Journey of Self-Discovery:[/b] Though the cute and loveable characters and cozy world take center stage; Fall of Porcupine is not afraid to tackle serious topics to truly find out where it hurts, and why
[*] [b]Secrets Beneath the Surface:[/b] At first glance, the small town is a warm, friendly place where everyone knows and greets each other. However, dark shadows lurk beyond this friendly facade. Discover the town’s secrets, and be on guard!
[*] [b]Fondly Familiar Gameplay:[/b] Fall of Porcupine is a highly polished and unique story-adventure for those who love mystery RPGs and heartwarming stories. The simple but fun gameplay-mechanics and creatively designed characters and world speak to mainstream-, indie-, and first time-gamers alike.[/list]


[b]ASSEMBLE and BUNTSPECHT.GAMES will present a playable version of Fall Of Porcupine at gamescom 2022 in both the Indie Arena Booth (IAB) and the Indie Area Home of Indies (IAHoI) in Hall 10.2.[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1710540/Fall_of_Porcupine/

notes.notes:
Scrubs and Players, 

How are you feeling today? We hope you're wonderful!  

With the end of the year approaching, we, the team from BUNTSPECHT.GAMES, wanted to take a moment to thank each and every one of you who took the time to play the demo for our game, Fall of Porcupine. 

This year has been nothing short of amazing for us. As a fledgeling developer, releasing our first game can be scary, but your overwhelmingly positive feedback to the demo warmed our hearts, and we take great pride and motivation from that.  

While we are working hard to bring you more from Finley and friends soon, we have decided to make the demo temporarily unavailable, while we incorporate some of your valuable feedback into a future version of “Last Days of Summer”. 

But don't worry - we will be back soon with exciting updates and more stories straight out of Porcupine.  

Until then, thank you again for your support. Enjoy the holiday season and stay healthy. 

BUNTSPECHT.GAMES
